planned_checks.criterion: Racket, shuttle, net/court and participating athlete make badminton readable in one photograph; exact low-return mechanics are baseline comparison criteria, not user locks.
Foreground hand grips a continuous racket handle-shaft-head; shuttle and string bed are spatially distinct; shoes support lunge.
Inspect dark bob/fringe, dark eyes and broad facial appearance against the actually supplied portrait; distinguish partial resemblance from identity proof.
Every useful adopted source has exact CID/RID/hash and an explicit before/after prompt delta absent from baseline, plus an observable pixel target. Exposed but unselected sources count as zero.
Face, playing task, support and court context cohere; richer unseen backstory is not reported as pixel evidence.
